label: state-compression
why: 163 carriers; a 25-problem sample plus a full census of one stratum put the justified rate near 30%. The predictor is a co-label, not the judge or the difficulty: with a bitmask sibling it is usually right, with only generic `dynamic-programming` it was 0 for 10 and LeetCode's own bitmask tag agrees on 0 of 52. See experiments/15-label-precision-sample.md.
